messages:
Nina CS: Praxis dedicated cutover planning  quick note: customer agreed to trial quota windows but wants a clear rollback + billing guardrail.
Jorge SRE: Proposed windows: 07:00-09:00 20%, 09:00-12:00 50%, 12:00-15:00 100%. 30m observation holds between ramps.
Mei Platform: Will encode windows in control plane. Autoscale: target 68% GPU util, cool-down 4m, scale step 20%. Enable short burst +25% for 15m per window.
Arjun Eng: Add degraded-path: if p99 > 600ms for 5m -> route 25% to quantized model, drop quotas by 35%, trigger alert.
Priya (Praxis): Sounds good. We will cap client retries to 2 and add 300ms jitter. Also request a pre-cutover SLO snapshot for billing transparency.
Jorge SRE: I'll run a burn today: waves 300rps x10m, 800rps x15m, 1.2k rps x8m against staging-eu. Will capture p50/p95/p99, retry counts, OOMs.
ops-bot: loadtest scheduled by Jorge SRE for 2024-09-18T13:00:00Z  logs to /var/logs/loadtests/praxis-2024-09-18.log
Nina CS: Action items: Mei push windows, Jorge post full results, Arjun add fallback flag, I will confirm contract burst clause with finance.
Arjun Eng: Quick load command for reference:
```
hey-load --target https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/generate --rate 800 --duration 12m --token $TOKEN
```
Jorge SRE: Preflight done: 300rps p95=110ms, 800rps p95=230ms, 1.2k p95=410ms with a few 700ms spikes; no OOMs. Uploading full trace now.
Nina CS: Thanks all  will set final go/no-go call after finance confirms billing guardrail. :thumbsup:
